title: Clarify Telemetry tab operating state
summary: Adds frontend-only Telemetry tab presentation that classifies raw hardware telemetry into operator-readable states.
reason: Operators need to quickly understand whether media processing is idle, CPU-bound, GPU-bound, memory-bound, unavailable, stale, or degraded.
behavior_before: The Telemetry tab showed raw CPU, NVENC, RAM, and GPU values, while the visible readiness status primarily described telemetry availability.
behavior_after: The Telemetry tab shows a visible operating state, next-step guidance, KPI chips, chart timing metadata, and non-specialist GPU encoder wording without changing backend telemetry contracts.
tests_added: Updated static WebView tests that asserted old Telemetry/NVENC copy.
Updated tests/webview/test_webview_browser_telemetry_smoke.py to cover idle, GPU-bound, CPU-bound, memory-pressure, CPU/RAM-only, degraded, stale, chart metadata, KPI chips, and operator wording.
